name: Self-falsification / adversarial counter-design (AX-10)
families: llm-adjudicated-critique: LLM critiques LLM with a model deciding whether the refutation stands

committed-mutation-kill: hash-committed finite mutation-operator and counter-design class M with 100% kill matrix as an offline-recomputable release artifact; surviving mutant = typed UNKNOWN blocking release and escalating as a certificate-carrying transition. Per the v2 AX-10 correction (CF P1-4): mutation kill over the committed finite class is the FLOOR mechanism for the unverified remainder — proof-carrying exclusion of entire INFINITE defect classes (a machine-checked functional-correctness proof refutes all semantics-altering mutants relative to the spec for the verified perimeter) strictly exceeds it wherever a proof covers the seat, and Rice's theorem bars deciding arbitrary code, not checking a supplied proof

kernel-checked-counterexamples: disproofs, countermodels, and defeaters that are themselves Lean/SMT-verified rather than judged (absorbs: Learning to Disprove, VERGE, formal-referee self-play, LogiKEy Nitpick/Nunchaku model-finding as routine audit candidate, differential random testing against the formal model, ValidArgLLM extract-and-execute divergence detection)

n-version-formalization-diffing: independently generated formalizations of the same provision with SAT-exhaustive enumeration of behavioral disagreements as the ambiguity/escalation signal (absorbs: 'By Their Fruits', round-trip drift detection as the standing-invariant variant) — its ADMISSION-time use is now seated at DIM-16 (n-version-formalization-admission); this DIM-13 family is its falsification use over already-admitted artifacts

fresh-context-kill-mandate-critics: institutionalized adversarial phase gates with structurally independent reviewers, cross-model families, context isolation (absorbs: Refute-or-Promote); guarantee-form statement per the v2 AX-10 R4 de-tailoring (IH P1-5a): structurally independent adversarial review with no access to implementer rationale is a blocking admission gate, and every finding reaches a recorded terminal disposition — fixed, refuted-with-proof, or tracked-to-scheduled-removal

eliminations.lemma: Pre-registered dominance conjecture on AX-10: R1 vs the R5 guarantee profile. The v1 ground 'B0 already runs mutation-kill suites, so the family is strictly below the demonstrated floor' is retyped: that is attainment-witness material, and 'no vendor declares any adversarial mechanism' is an ABSENCE of declaration, which under the v2 evidence discipline establishes NOTHING (stays UNKNOWN) — it is recorded as motivation only. Adjudicated by full verdicts against retained representative K-COM using KNOWN_UPPER_BOUND caps where behavioral evidence exists.

Violates H1 and H8: the refutation verdict is a statistical judgment, not a recomputable artifact. Kernel-checked refutation is demonstrated at scale (Lean-verified disproofs), so nothing is lost by the constraint. LLM critics SURVIVE as generators inside fresh-context-kill-mandate-critics — only adjudication must be non-statistical.
